meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 需要提交或查历史时会先检查仓库现状，只提交你要求的部分，照仓库原有风格写提交说明；遇到“谁改的、什么时候加的”这类问题，用 git 命令查证后给出带证据的答案；重写历史前会先征求你的确认，不碰受保护的分支。
howto.when: 当你要提交代码、处理暂存内容，或问“这行是谁写的”“这个功能什么时候加的”等 git 历史问题时触发；普通改代码不触发，除非你明确要求做 git 操作。

say.text: 把这几个文件的改动分成两个提交，先提交 A 和 B，再提交 C。
say.note: 会按你说的分组，分两次提交。

say.text: 查一下这行是谁最后改的，是什么时候。
say.note: 用 git blame 定位并给出证据。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压成一个。
say.note: 会走 rebase 压缩，并且先确认再动手。

howto.what_en: When the user commits or asks about git history, Claude first inspects the repo state, commits only the requested changes with the repo's dominant message style, answers history questions with evidence from commands like blame/bisect, and asks before rewriting shared branches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task needs a commit, staging, or git-history investigation such as who wrote something or when it was added. Not triggered for ordinary code edits unless the user explicitly asks for git work.

say_en.text: Split these changes into two commits—first A and B, then C.
say_en.note: Commits are grouped as you asked.

say_en.text: Who last changed this line and when?
say_en.note: Uses git blame and shows evidence.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Goes through rebase and confirms first.
